PR surface: Source +468, Tests +469, Docs +27, Generated 0. Total +964 across 14 files.

Reproducibility: not applicable. as a feature PR. The contributor supplied before/after live ClickClack proof for durable activity rows, but current main lacks `agentActivity` and the proof does not show the later attribution fields being accepted or persisted.

target.title: feat(clickclack): publish durable agent activity rows (commentary + tool)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `extensions/clickclack` channel extension only delivered the final prose reply, so a ClickClack channel showed nothing while an agent turn ran, even though the ClickClack server natively stores and renders durable `agent_commentary` / `agent_tool` message rows (with `turn_id` grouping and a dedicated non-inherited `agent_activity:write` bot scope). This PR adds an opt-in activity publisher to the extension: when an account sets `agentActivity: true` and its bot token carries `agent_activity:write`, streamed commentary and tool progress from the in-process `replyOptions.onItemEvent` seam are POSTed as durable activity rows (and PATCHed as snapshots grow), coalesced so one logical step becomes one row. Tool rows render through the shared `buildChannelProgressDraftLine` formatter, so ClickClack shows the same tool name + command detail as the Discord/Slack/Telegram progress lines. Publishing is best-effort: transport failures are logged and never interrupt final text delivery, and the flag defaults to off so stock setups and older ClickClack servers are untouched.

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof

**Behavior:** With a ClickClack account bound to an agent, sending a channel message runs the agent turn invisibly: no commentary, no tool activity, only the final reply. After this PR (with `agentActivity: true` and a bot token carrying `agent_activity:write`), durable commentary and tool rows stream into the channel while the turn runs.

**Real environment:** Real gateway built from this repo (`pnpm build`, `node openclaw.mjs gateway`), real ClickClack server built from upstream `clickclack` source at `main@51a375d` (`go build ./apps/api/cmd/clickclack`, sqlite, dev bootstrap), real model turns (`anthropic/claude-opus-4-6`) with exec tools, stock ClickClack web UI in Chromium driven through the composer. BEFORE gateway is built at the merge base `bd2740fedc`; AFTER gateway is built at this PR head. Same server instance, same channel name, same steps.

**Exact steps:**
1. Run the ClickClack server (`clickclack serve`, dev bootstrap) and create an empty `#agent-demo` channel.
2. Configure `channels.clickclack` with `baseUrl`, a bot token, `replyMode: "agent"`; BEFORE uses the merge-base build (no `agentActivity` key exists there), AFTER uses this PR's build with `agentActivity: true` and a bot token that carries `agent_activity:write`.
3. Start the gateway, open `#agent-demo` in the ClickClack web UI, and type into the composer: "Check what OS version this server is running, how much free disk space it has, and how many files are in your workspace directory. Narrate what you are doing between steps, then give me a two-line summary."
4. Watch the channel while the turn runs, then open the reply thread.

**Evidence (before):** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ragesaq/openclaw/proof/clickclack-agent-activity-evidence/clickclack-before-prose-only.gif (frame-by-frame contact sheet: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ragesaq/openclaw/proof/clickclack-agent-activity-evidence/before-final_sheet.png)

**Evidence (after):** https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ragesaq/openclaw/proof/clickclack-agent-activity-evidence/clickclack-after-agent-activity.gif (frame-by-frame contact sheet: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ragesaq/openclaw/proof/clickclack-agent-activity-evidence/after-final_sheet.png)

**Observed result:** BEFORE: the channel stays empty for the whole turn; a lone "1 reply" thread chip appears at the end and the thread contains only the final summary. AFTER: one `agent_commentary` row ("Checking OS version, disk space, and workspace file count all at once…") and three `agent_tool` rows ("🛠️ show /etc/os-release …", "🛠️ df -h /", "🛠️ find files in … -> run wc") stream into the channel during the turn, grouped by `turn_id`, and the final summary lands in the thread as before. Stored rows verified over the ClickClack REST API (`kind: agent_commentary` / `agent_tool`, shared `turn_id`).

**What was not tested:** DM conversations (the publisher targets `direct_conversation_id`, covered by unit tests, but the live capture is a channel); multi-account setups beyond one account; a ClickClack server predating the activity kinds (degradation there relies on the opt-in default staying off plus best-effort error logging, exercised in unit tests, not live); non-embedded (CLI-backend) agent runtimes.

### Clean-room validation
- Command: fresh clone of `pull/99954/head` (`82bc62ed46`) inside a stock `node:22-bookworm` container: `git fetch --depth 1 origin pull/99954/head && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm vitest run extensions/clickclack`
- Provider / lease: plain Docker container (crabbox delegated providers unavailable on this host: `blacksmith` and `sbx` binaries not installed, no AWS credentials — stated per proof policy rather than skipped silently)
- Result: **34/34 tests passed, 6/6 files** on the fresh clone

### Tests, build, lint
- `pnpm vitest run extensions/clickclack` — 6 files, 32 tests passed (includes 7 new activity-publisher tests + new accounts/http-client/inbound cases)
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions` — exit 0
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` — exit 0
- `pnpm oxlint extensions/clickclack` — 0 warnings, 0 errors
- `pnpm config:channels:check` — bundled channel-config metadata in sync (regenerated in this PR for the new `agentActivity` key)
- `pnpm build` — full build passes; the AFTER evidence runs this exact build

## Findings
None open. Two defects were caught and fixed during my own validation pass before posting: (1) the generated bundled channel-config metadata initially wasn't regenerated, which made gateway startup reject `agentActivity` as an unknown key; (2) item events are gated on tool-summary visibility, so the publisher declares channel-owned progress rendering (`suppressDefaultToolProgressMessages: true`) to receive events regardless of session verbose mode, matching the draft-compositor precedent.

## Lineage
None. Consumes the existing `replyOptions.onItemEvent` / `commentaryProgressEnabled` seam already used by the Discord/Telegram/Slack draft paths. The ClickClack server side (activity kinds, `turn_id`, `agent_activity:write` scope) is already merged upstream in the ClickClack repo.

## Remaining risk
Low. The feature is off by default and fully additive; with the flag off the extension behavior is byte-identical to before. With the flag on, publisher failures are logged best-effort and cannot break final delivery (single promise chain isolates transport errors). The main thing to watch is row volume on long multi-tool turns: one row per tool call plus one per commentary segment, PATCH-coalesced within a 700ms debounce window.
